name: Pozo de Urama (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pozo de Urama (a castle on red, a well on blue and a plant on white).
history: Municipal flag of Pozo de Urama; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pozo de Urama arms — castle on red, well on blue and plant on white
